summary: Each edition was independently compared with every clause of the selected Greek. Both preserve the four roles, three service actions, agreement/peace/listening sequence, stone groups, Lord designations, positive assertion that evil was found, and all repeated repentance conditions, timing restrictions, denial of a place, exclusion, and final position beside the tower. Contextual repentance follows project policy; doulos does not occur here. The notes accurately disclose the alternatives described in the supplied project report, including corrections, gaps, bracketed restorations, editorial emendations, and mediated Ethiopic evidence, without replacing the selected working readings. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Acceptance is limited to the supplied source, English, and reported evidence; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, certify handwriting, or establish exhaustive collation.
